name: IPI (Improve Paragraphs)
description: Adds extra functionality to improve the Paragraphs editing experience (library/browser integration).
project_description:
If you have ever use "Paragraphs library item" module, you may be frustrated by the lack of scope for the paragraphs.

 This module is for you.

 It will allow you to easily manage paragraphs scope in paragraphs browser.

You can manage paragraphs scope in two places :

- In the entity reference revisions field

- In the paragraph type itself

 By managing paragraphs scope, you will be able to see only the good paragraphs type in entity browser.

 Here's also few extra features :

- Easily see paragraphs library item : a pink background is setup

- Easily manage paragraphs library item without leaving entity browser : You will be able to edit/add paragraphs within modals

- If you use field_config_cardinality module, field widgets compatible are define

 I highly recommend that you check README file before use this module.

One configuration file must be manualy import and some patches (of paragraphs browser and drupal core) must be install.
